flows:
Navigate to https://www.colorhexa.com/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Press the Tab key twice as the first two keyboard actions, before judging whether the target can be reached.
Continue with Tab or Shift+Tab as needed.
Open the red swatch next to the color search box with Enter.
Confirm the color spectrum and hue slider become visible.

summary:
After the required two Tab presses, the run used one Shift+Tab and assumed that focus had reached the swatch. It had not verified the focused control or continued through the keyboard order. Enter therefore submitted the search form.
Update the automation to inspect the active visible control after each Tab or Shift+Tab and only press Enter after confirming focus is on the swatch. If the swatch cannot be reached after a complete keyboard traversal, record that separately with focus-order evidence.
one_liner: The run pressed Enter while focus was on the search form, so the homepage reloaded instead of opening the color picker.

verdict.root_cause: After the required two Tab presses, the run used one Shift+Tab and assumed that focus had reached the swatch. It had not verified the focused control or continued through the keyboard order. Enter therefore submitted the search form.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent caused the terminal outcome by acting on an assumed focus position. The two required Tab actions and one reverse Tab do not establish that the swatch was focused; the subsequent Enter was sent to the search input/form and triggered its normal submission. The supplied evidence does not prove that a correctly focused, keyboard-operable swatch failed to open.
